note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after a78870fd39). RFC 9568 Section 7.1 says "It MUST verify that the VRRP packet type is 1 (ADVERTISEMENT)." TestDecodeGoldenV3IPv4 now decodes the RFC 9568 message-only golden G2 under the default-mode lookup instead of the pseudo-header golden G2c, and lost only the removed MsgOnlyChecksum assertion; the subtests of TestNegativeReferenceBugs other than N1 gained only the FillChecksum mode argument. The positive is still a fully conforming advert, the checksum check precedes the checks this row names so a wrong form would fail with ErrChecksum and not pass silently, and each negative still asserts its exact sentinel.
